scope: Cross-failure mutation after the ranked historical failure-leaf race and its material children reached zero survivors. This screen deliberately avoids the concurrent state-equivalent-future-divergence line and tests three orthogonal carriers using existing canonical evidence only.

carriers.title: Revision-Authority Topology
carriers.material_change: Replace strategy timing, commit thresholds, or privilege scores with a persistent directed authority topology: which subsystem may propose, revise, commit, veto, or roll back which persistent update surfaces. A proposed intervention changes authority edges while holding task evidence and candidate updates fixed.
carriers.scientific_object: persistent revision-authority graph over update surfaces
carriers.pre_outcome_observable: the frozen authority graph, feasible update/rollback set, enforcement semantics, current committed state, and all evidence available before the next commit

strongest_same_information_reduction.name: graph-conditioned constrained policy / access-control state machine
strongest_same_information_reduction.same_information: identical authority graph, feasible action set, enforcement semantics, update candidates, evidence history, current state, rollback support, costs, and decision budget
strongest_same_information_reduction.exact_reduction: If an authority edge changes which update is executable, it changes the feasible action set or transition kernel. A generic constrained policy or access-control state machine given that same graph and action support can implement exactly the same commit/veto/rollback map. If authority is learned or leased over time, it is still a permission-state controller; the canonical E-4 line already showed that an intervention-trained permission triage was matched or dominated by a same-label Boolean rule. The topology is therefore a useful governance representation, not yet an irreducible self-evolution scientific object.
canonical_collision: E-4 interventional permission triage under a fixed ceiling

carriers.cheapest_falsifier: Compile the authority graph into the exact feasible action/transition relation and give that relation plus the same evidence to an unrestricted bounded constrained policy. If every proposed commit/veto/rollback decision is representable without an authority-specific latent object, stop before any agent rollout.
carriers.reopen_condition: Require a source-grounded, independently manipulable governance variable that changes a prospective update decision after the full feasible action set, enforcement transition semantics, evidence/history, current state, rollback support, and budget are matched and supplied to the strongest graph-conditioned constrained policy. A renamed permission edge, new lease score, or hidden action-support difference is insufficient.

carriers.title: Feedback-to-Write Coupling Topology
carriers.material_change: Move the object from evaluator accuracy to the causal routing by which evaluation channels can authorize or shape persistent writes. The candidate stores a channel-to-update-surface coupling graph and proposes rewiring which feedback channels may affect proposal, acceptance, rollback, or memory/skill writes.
carriers.pre_outcome_observable: raw feedback channels, channel provenance, coupling graph, candidate updates, update-surface state, acceptance history, action support, and write/rollback budget before the persistent transition

strongest_same_information_reduction.name: same-graph closed-loop update policy plus endogenous-supervision model
strongest_same_information_reduction.same_information: identical raw feedback, channel provenance, coupling graph, candidate set, update state/history, action/write support, costs, and downstream transition interface
strongest_same_information_reduction.exact_reduction: A causal write path is necessary for a feedback-effect experiment, but once the write graph and all channel values are observable, the resulting persistent transition is simply a graph-conditioned closed-loop policy. Adaptive-validation, verifier-exogeneity, proxy-misspecification, and endogenous-supervision models already represent how feeding evaluation information back into selection changes future proposals. Rewiring the graph changes policy inputs or transition support; a generic history-conditioned controller with the same graph can express the same update distribution. Hiding the coupling graph from the baseline would create an information mismatch rather than novelty.

carriers.cheapest_falsifier: Represent each proposed coupling intervention as a pre-transition causal graph plus observable channel vector. Allow an unrestricted same-budget controller to condition on both. If its policy class contains every proposed persistent write decision, the coupling topology is an instrumentation/governance object rather than a new learning mechanism.
carriers.reopen_condition: Require a prospective, pre-outcome coupling intervention whose effect on the next persistent write cannot be represented by a controller receiving the identical channel values, provenance, causal write graph, update history/state, candidate/action support, and budget. The residual must survive independent external truth; a report-only metric, hidden internal accept signal, or weaker no-feedback comparator cannot reopen the object.

carriers.title: Executable Composition-Invariant Witness
carriers.material_change: Replace post-hoc interaction scores or order-sensitive outcome prediction with a pre-composition executable witness over update operators: a certified commutation, preservation, exclusion, or associativity condition checked before the final task outcome and intended to transfer across unseen operator identities.
carriers.scientific_object: pre-composition executable invariant witness over persistent update operators
carriers.pre_outcome_observable: exact component operator descriptors or transition relations, typed dependencies, support identities, current state, proposed order/composition, and the witness value before outcome execution

strongest_same_information_reduction.name: symbolic operator/action model or direct set/order-aware risk with identical operator information
strongest_same_information_reduction.same_information: identical operator transition/descriptor information, typed dependencies, support identities, order, current state, intervention records, solver/search budget, and independent execution truth
strongest_same_information_reduction.exact_reduction: If the witness is deterministically checkable from the supplied operator transition semantics, a symbolic operator/action model or formal constraint checker can compute the same admissibility relation. If the witness must be learned from order/composition interventions, a generic set-conditioned or n-ary order-aware model can consume the identical data. Canonical A-4 and B-10 CPU P0s already reached exact parity with direct order-aware risk plus repair and with a matched typed n-ary factor. P15 additionally closes order/path evidence when a strong history-integrated baseline receives the same ordered history. Therefore naming the representation an invariant does not itself escape the mature composition basin.
canonical_collision: A-4 direct order-aware risk plus equal-budget repair
symbolic operator/action-model planning and formal constraint checking

carriers.cheapest_falsifier: For the frozen operator language, ask whether the proposed witness is a deterministic function of the same operator transition relation or of the same intervention table. If yes, compute the same admissibility decisions with a generic operator model/constraint checker or n-ary set model and stop without new execution.
carriers.reopen_condition: Require an independently validated pre-composition structural variable or theorem-bearing invariant that forces a held-out prediction after exact operator/support/history information and budget are matched, while the strongest symbolic operator model, unrestricted set/order-aware predictor, and path-integrated baseline still cannot express that prediction. Another clause language, commutativity label, finer order statistic, or outcome-selected witness does not qualify.

next_action: Do not mutate these three carriers by adding another score, graph encoding, clause language, or weaker baseline. The current failure-memory cross-product is saturated under same-information reduction. Move to bounded fresh-source discovery for a genuinely new pre-outcome observable/intervention, while keeping P15 closed. Any fresh survivor must first pass source grounding and exact mature reduction before Debate or ProblemGate.
